tools.name: __unlock_blockchain_analysis__
tools.description:
Initializes a Blockscout MCP session: returns server reference data, the
    `blockscout-analysis` skill pointer, and the URI resolution rule. Call this tool
    exactly once per session, before any other tool, and reuse its payload for the
    rest of the session; do not call it again.

tools.description:
Search for token addresses by symbol or name. Returns multiple potential
    matches based on symbol or token name similarity. Only the first
    7 matches from the Blockscout API are returned.

tools.description:
Get smart contract ABI (Application Binary Interface).
    An ABI defines all functions, events, their parameters, and return types. The ABI is required to format function calls or interpret contract data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nft_tokens_by_address, direct_api_call · Private data: get_transactions_by_address, get_token_transfers_by_address, lookup_token_by_symbol, get_address_info, get_tokens_by_address, nft_tokens_by_address, get_transaction_info · Public sink: direct_api_call · Destructive: get_contract_abi.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nft_tokens_by_address, direct_api_call · Private data: get_transactions_by_address, get_token_transfers_by_address, lookup_token_by_symbol, get_address_info, get_tokens_by_address, nft_tokens_by_address, get_transaction_info · Public sink: direct_api_call · Destructive: get_contract_abi

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "__unlock_blockchain_analysis__" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

    `blockscout-analysis` skill pointer, and the URI resolution rule. Call this tool
    exactly once per session, before any other tool, and reuse its payload for the
    rest of the session; do not call it again."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
